title: Forward Pass Domain Adaptation (Without Cross-Layer Backpropagation)
abstract: arXiv:2608.14563v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Forward-Pass-Only MLP training (FPO) adapts large language models without a backward pass through the model body, achieving 2.7--3.2x the throughput of standard fine-tuning at ~40% less peak training memory, while leaving off-domain benchmarks within seed-noise of baseline, a property that full-network fine-tuning does not reliably reproduce. FPO rests on a single empirical observation: at late layers of a transformer, the output-layer prediction error approximates the true gradient with cosine similarity 0.47--0.59 across six public models we survey. We introduce a two-minute diagnostic that quantifies this approximation per layer for any model, identifying where late-layer adaptation is viable. Informed by the diagnostic, FPO computes a single error signal at the output and applies it to each target layer. translated_title: 前向传播域适应（无需跨层反向传播）
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14563v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：仅前向传播的MLP训练（FPO）在不通过模型主体进行反向传播的情况下适应大型语言模型，实现了标准微调吞吐量的2.7至3.2倍，峰值训练内存减少约40%，同时使域外基准测试结果保持在基线噪声范围内，这是全网络微调无法可靠复现的特性。FPO基于一个单一的经验观察：在Transformer的深层，输出层的预测误差近似于真实梯度，其余弦相似度在我们调查的六个公共模型中为0.47至0.59。我们引入了一个两分钟的诊断方法，可量化每个层中这种近似的程度，从而识别深层适应可行的位置。基于该诊断，FPO在输出层计算一个单一误差信号，并将其应用于每个目标层。各层之间不传播信号，且在任何阶段都不构建自动求导图。我们在三个模型家族上评估了FPO。
tldr: 本文提出一种仅前向传播的域适应方法，通过利用深层输出误差与梯度的近似性，实现高效大模型微调，同时节省内存并保持基准性能。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a forward-pass-only domain adaptation method that leverages the approximation between output error and gradient at deep layers, enabling efficient large-model fine-tuning with memory savings and preserved benchmark performance.
